_comment: DEMO, not the default: GPS that gets worse or disappears by PLACE instead of by time.
Run it in the window (teleop on, so you can drive into the shadow yourself):
./lab sim --world production --config config/demo_gps_shadow.json
./lab sim --world arena --config config/demo_gps_shadow.json
Watch it from the outside (the odometry ghost and the rubber show the drift directly):
./lab run --world production --config config/demo_gps_shadow.json \
--robot muster --controller student/solution.py --seconds 30
Or make it one student task by measuring it:
./lab grade --world production --config config/demo_gps_shadow.json --task kinematik \
--controller student/solution.py --log messung.csv
Why a file and not the default: the graded tasks in config/tasks.json are calibrated on the
default GPS (sigma_xy 0.06 m in experiment 1, 0.5/0.8 m plus a timed outage in experiment 2).
A zone that is always on would silently change what every filter is graded against. So the
default is gps.zones = [] and a demo asks for the zones it wants. Do not use this file when
you grade, unless you also recalibrate the thresholds.
Semantics (sensors.GpsSensor._zones): rectangles are world metres, the first zone containing
the robot wins, sigma_scale multiplies gps.sigma_xy, bias_xy is added to the existing bias
(multipath pushes the fix away from the reflector), block means 'no fix at all'.
Broken entries are dropped rather than crashing the run. Turn the drawing off with `s`.
